title: DECSET 1053 — SCO function keys
summary: CSI ? 1053 h enables SCO function key mode. CSI ? 1053 l disables it.

frame.note: DEC private modes are CSI sequences with a leading '?' (0x3F) private-parameter prefix. Set = final byte 'h' (DECSET); reset = final byte 'l' (DECRST).

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: a DEC private mode is a CSI sequence ending at its final byte ('h' to set, 'l' to reset).

params.name: Enable (DECSET)
params.meaning: CSI ? 1053 h SCO function keys mode

gotchas: SCO function key mode changes the escape sequences sent by function keys.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: DECSET/DECRST 1053 render as byte-exact CSI ? 1053 h/l sequences.
